ResilienceSoft - 10. Other site assets
- Play Book (https://www.resiliencesoft.com/assets/Resiliencesoft.pdf): a 1-page PDF reading only "WELCOME TO RESILIENCESOFT ORGANIZATION"; it has no further text.
- Gallery (/gallery): category filters only (All, Office, Activity, Employee, Tour, Party); the images have no captions.
- Homepage banners: "Expert on These Technologies", "Business with Own Mobile App", "Get Web Hosting Solution", "Go With Social Media Marketing".
- Homepage CTAs: "Consult Now", "Send Message", "Request a call back".
- Footer copyright: © 2026 ResilienceSoft (the web hosting page still shows 2025).
- SEO keyword focus (meta): software company, website design and development, Android app development, digital marketing, SEO, ISO-certified training and internships in Bilaspur, Raipur and Chhattisgarh.

ResilienceSoft - 11. Gaps and inconsistencies to resolve before using as AI data
1. **Not on the public site at all:** ResilioHub / WhatsApp CRM (resiliohub.com), NAVIGATOR_AI, the Android TV signage app, the n8n automation work, and any in-house AI work. Please add these from your own docs.
2. **Two addresses** appear (footer: "Opposite CG Plaza"; About/Contact: "Opposite Vinayak Netralaya, Link Road"). One may be the older address.
3. **Team lists conflict.** Deepak Verma is "Manager" on the homepage and "Functional Manager" on the team page. Shreya Gupta is "Web Developer (PHP)", "Senior Software Developer" or "Senior PHP Developer" depending on the page. Your own name and Akash do not appear on the public team pages.
4. **Stat conflicts:** About says 250+ customers; homepage says "more than 100 clients". Homepage counters did not load.
5. **The SEO page text refers to "Brainpulse"** ("Brainpulse is the top SEO agency in India ... over two decades"), which looks copied from another company. The 2012 start and "two decades" also don't match. Don't train on that paragraph unchanged.
6. **Marketing copy is generic and repetitive.** Service pages repeat each text block twice (desktop and mobile) and read like boilerplate. For a model, it works better to rewrite them as short factual Q&A pairs.
7. **Product detail pages** (HousieMania, SharpQuiz, School Management, Path Lab, CRM/HRM and the rest) could not be opened from the crawl. Features, pricing, tech stack and screenshots need to come from you.
8. **No pricing, fees, durations, SLAs, tech process, case studies or legal pages** (privacy, terms) were found.

Q: What is ResilienceSoft?
A: ResilienceSoft is a software development company based in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, India. It offers website design and development, mobile app development, digital marketing, and ISO-certified IT training and paid internships. The company was established in 2012.

Q: When was ResilienceSoft established?

Q: Where is ResilienceSoft located?
